items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:110:1
items.html: The lower beard, which is at the place of the Yesod of ZA himself, etc. It is known that there are three kinds of hairs that come out in three Partzufim [pl. of Partzuf]: in Ibur [impregnation], nursing, and Mochin, as is written above on page 1368, the passage beginning “And this.” See there. It is also known that from the side of the vessels it is always found that the upper ones grow first. And therefore the hairs of the Partzuf of the Ibur, which are the hairs of the Yesod, do not come except after the Mochin of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] have been completed for him, that is, after thirteen years. So that in Ibur and in nursing he has only the upper vessels of the hairs, that is, the hairs of the head alone, which are the discernment of GE of the hairs, as above in Part 13; and the discernment of the AHP of the hairs does not come except in Gadlut. For in the discernment of the Mochin of the Tzadi of Tzelem [image] of Gadlut, which are after thirteen years, he attains the discernment of the hairs of the Ibur, which are the hairs of the Yesod, called the lower beard, which is likewise the discernment of the Tzadi. And after this, when he attains the LM [Lamed-Mem] of Gadlut, which is in the course of twenty years, as is written further on, then he attains also the upper Dikna [beard] of the head, which is the discernment of the AHP of the hairs of Gadlut. And study well in the aforementioned Inner Light, on page 1368, for this is not the place to elaborate.
